product.name: User-Promotion Engine
product.description: A platform to run, track, and manage various user-promotion campaigns like referrals, loyalty, discounts, and coupons without coding.

product.name: Referral Campaigns
product.description: A tool to launch and manage referral programs that incentivize existing users to bring new customers with customizable rewards.

product.name: Action-Based Rewards
product.description: A system to create custom rewards triggered by specific user actions, milestones, or behaviors to drive engagement.

product.name: Wallet Management Module
product.description: A module to automate and manage multiple loyalty wallets, tracking points, transactions, and redemptions with detailed analytics.

product.name: Coupon and Discount Campaigns
product.description: A feature to create, distribute, and control coupon and discount campaigns with flexible validation and redemption rules.

product.name: Campaign Analytics and Revenue Conversion Tracking
product.description: Analytics tools to monitor campaign performance, set KPIs, and track revenue conversion events for optimization.
